'''Mac''' was an old [[gambling droid]] that worked at the [[Last Stand Casino]]. Mac would play [[Sabacc/Legends|sabacc]] with the owner, [[Mortimon Galli]], and exchange barbs, puns, and anti-[[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] cracks.<ref name="Game" />
